cells.gaps: The newest figure, 7.89 per cent for November 2026, is above 5 per cent. The report of the rise does not state the bundle's validity; it is MTN's 5 GB bundle that SDN-001 gives as monthly.
cells.note: MTN Sudan raised its 5 GB bundle from SDG 12,500 to 16,500 by November 2026 (SDN-007), the cheapest 5 GB price reported: 7.89 per cent of average monthly income, within 10 and above 5, so 2.
